ai.betting_angles: UCLA's recent form is imposing, with wins over Princeton 55-34 and Arizona 76-44, while Cal Poly has dropped two of their last four games including losses of 51-64 at Idaho State and 65-85 versus UC Irvine. The all-time head-to-head record is completely one-sided at 8-0 in UCLA's favor, with the Bruins winning the most recent meeting 115-28. Our Elo model projects UCLA as a clear favorite, consistent with their perfect 4-0 start and the Mustangs' struggles against quality opposition.
ai.prediction_writeup: UCLA's perfect 4-0 start and 5-game winning streak indicate a team in elite form, most recently defeating Princeton 55-34. The all-time series record of 8-0 in UCLA's favor includes a dominant 115-28 victory in their last meeting. Cal Poly enters having won just one of their last two games, a narrow 57-55 win over Seattle U, and has never held the belt in program history. The Bruins' recent defensive performances, including holding UC Irvine to 42 points and Lehigh to 53, suggest Cal Poly will struggle to find offensive rhythm. UCLA retains the belt with a comfortable home victory.
